failure_class: A mobile refresh during image upload can drop or permanently hold gallery positions, hide every usable recovery control, and misreport the failure as an unrelated invalid field.
acceptance_rules: A persisted uploading position is restored as uncertain and can be reconciled when the server reports that position pending or committed.
A held slot with no surviving File keeps reconciliation incomplete, is polled with a finite delay, never offers an impossible retry, and exposes an authenticated gallery reset.
An unexpected failure of the status action maps to a gallery-specific user error even when the backend detail contains no photo keyword.
Gallery reset is owner-scoped, draft-only, and advances a durable generation under the submission lock before clearing images and tickets.
A worker that claimed a ticket before reset is fenced from committing afterward by rechecking the durable generation under lock.
A session for another owner receives the same not-found result as a missing submission and cannot reset it.

required_env: SETTLER_BACKEND_REPO: local git repository containing the named backend objects; no network fetch is permitted

result_law: BUILT is not PASS. Only an independent verifier may bind and run the exact candidate. Missing/malformed subjects or environment failures are instrument_error with exit 2, never subject FAIL.
